start.dialog: An ancient temple has emerged from the melting glacier! Pre-Collapse architecture, perfectly preserved in ice! Scholars are excited, but there's something inside—guardians, traps, who knows what? Care to be the first to explore?
start.objective: Enter the newly revealed frozen temple

progress.dialog: Incredible! Ice-elemental guardians protecting a central chamber! They're not hostile unless you approach the inner sanctum. Solve the ice puzzles, avoid the guardians, and see what treasure awaits!
progress.objective: Solve the temple's ice puzzles and reach the inner sanctum

complete.dialog: A frozen relic of the First Age! This changes our understanding of history! The Archaeological Society pays handsomely—and gives you this Frostward Ring! It grants immunity to ice magic!

party_comments.kade: Ancient temples, ice puzzles, and treasure! Classic adventuring!
party_comments.twist: The architecture suggests a civilization that worshipped winter itself.
party_comments.nix7: Historical preservation: exceptional. Artifact recovery: complete.
